# PicoSHA2

Unmodified `picosha2.h` and `LICENSE` from
https://github.com/okdshin/PicoSHA2/tree/161cb3fc4170fa7a3eca9e582cebd27cc4d1fe29
(MIT, copyright 2017 okdshin).

Git blobs: header `ef965e65232f20d1bda14c9b87165f6640024d3f`, license
`b6658bbc98a5b198a49fce48bc2aec7283bef62a`.

Used by the shared native checkpoint utility for integrity hashing. No
platform crypto dependency or locally invented hash algorithm is introduced.
This license applies to these upstream files, not to the surrounding project.
